title: Index Funds vs Individual Stock Investment Risk
content: Investing in broad market Index Funds (e.g. NIFTY 50, NIFTY Next 50) eliminates single-stock concentration risk by spreading investment across top market capitalization companies. Individual stocks carry idiosyncratic business, management, and sector risks that can result in total capital loss. Index funds offer low expense ratios (0.05-0.20%), eliminate manager stock-selection risk, and consistently track broad economic growth.
